objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline or document in DHC VISION, including content, properties, lifecycle status, release, distribution, archiving and versioning.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The default document name includes the document type abbreviation, a cross-client consecutive 4-digit number for each type, and the title.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected corresponding document type of the document.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: The abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number_per_type
attributes.description: A cross-client consecutive 4-digit number for each document type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title included in the document name.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: A document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: A document property maintained to link documents to Master data.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: A document property maintained to link documents to Master data.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: A document property maintained to link documents to Master data.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document and used in workflow and lifecycle contexts.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the registered author and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser_incl._translation
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used with the Valid from date to calculate the Valid until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid from and Period of extended validity.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing User Groups and persons in relation to email notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing User Groups and persons regarding distribution of the workflow task when the next version is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A configurable type used to classify documents and select templates; examples include policies, guidelines, procedural instructions and work instructions.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document type.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The type abbreviation used in document names.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The document level corresponding to the document type.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The period for which a check of extended validity is necessary; a period of 3 years is set in the DHC VISION standard.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The archive duration defined for each document type; a period of 10 years is set in the DHC VISION standard.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: An object attached in the system when creating new documents or adding information objects to documents.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: An external file that can be uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: A standard MS Office format on which new documents can be generated, such as Excel, Word or PowerPoint.

objs.name: category
objs.description: A grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose, such as Master data or Control (release).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the category.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document added to a main document and automatically released with the release of the main document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person using the system who may be assigned authorizations, roles, workflow tasks, distribution or acknowledgement responsibilities.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: The language used to determine visibility of a released translated document.

objs.name: person
objs.description: A person assignable for authorizations, distribution lists or workflow participation.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group used to assign authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access or role-specific availability.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user group.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: A group defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents to provide read and change rights to users or persons.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: A permission assigned at group or person level for documents and related details.

attributes.name: read_right
attributes.description: Permission to read or view a document or object.

attributes.name: write_right
attributes.description: Permission to change a document or object.

attributes.name: change_right
attributes.description: Permission to change documents and related details.

objs.name: system_role
objs.description: A role implemented in DHC VISION to provide users with appropriate functions according to their area of application.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the system role.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: The license role shown in brackets for the system role.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created for a document without affecting the document content or version history and managed in the document cockpit.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Indicates whether a change proposal is completed or planned for implementation.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: A note about an existing Change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: A request created for a selected released document to declare it invalid and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list for each document assigning User Groups or persons for distribution and acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: The type of distribution, either Distribution by e-mail or Distribution for acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific dashboard listing relevant documents and document-related details for users.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The dashboard name.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The report name.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: A parameter available for reports that influences evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: A criterion available for reports that filters result lists.

attributes.name: traffic_light_status
attributes.description: A traffic light display used in certain status reports.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation of acknowledgement requested from distribution recipients and documented in the system.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The acknowledgement status used in reports and overviews.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature used by workflow participants to complete release, review or approval tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: Functionality enabling complete traceability in approval processes.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: A task assigned to workflow participants and notified by the system.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The status of a workflow task.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: An e-mail notification sent by the system about workflow tasks, releases, acknowledgements, change proposals or validity processes.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that is checked and released with workflow support.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The original language version must be in the Released state before translation.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language in which a released document is visible to authorized readers.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the corresponding document is visible in a client.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data to which documents can be linked through maintained document properties, for example IT applications.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A process with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational unit with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: The group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A specific user group that retains read access to archived documents when other authorizations are revoked.
